company_profile.founding_note: The Latif family began business in Mumbai in 1901 as a contractor for Burmah Shell, transporting oil and petrol.
company_profile.services: Project financing, property development, pre-construction management and design, and construction delivery.

section.title: 124 Years of Experience — Since 1901
section.p: It was in this year that the Latif family first started business in Mumbai by becoming a contractor for Burmah Shell (now BPCL) for transporting oil and petrol. From then onward there was no looking back for the group
In 1962 the business expanded into the Timber and Interior industry sector.
In 1981 the business grew to incorporate an export-focused entity. Our experience and background give us a competitive advantage both in terms of procurement and quality control.
Operating throughout Mumbai, we are a company which is built on strong foundations of integrity and reliability.
At Burj Constructions, we love what we do, and we are extremely proud of the extensive range of projects that we have successfully delivered.
We provide a total solutions service covering project financing, property development, pre-construction management and design, alongside a first-class construction delivery capability.

Starting in 2009, our company has successfully redeveloped and delivered 500+residential and commercial units in south mumbai. We believe that “simplicity is the ultimate form of sophistication.” Our group plans to deliver approximately 500 more units in the following 3 years.
We have Developed area spanning upto 4 lakh sq.ft
We create flexible and functional facilities that meet the needs of our clients and end-users, now and in the future.

section.title: Working Together
section.p: We offer an end-to-end client experience that includes seamless communication, Project management consultancy, Turn key projects, budgeting, staffing, on-site organization, and solid quality handiwork every time.

section.title: Why Choose Us?
section.p: We work with architects and designers to produce beautiful, functional structures. Call us today and bring our project management skills and extensive construction experience to your next project.

section.title: Director's Desk
section.p: When we marked our venture into the real estate business in 1962 we kept our clients need at the core of our business times have changed technology have has evolved the world is moving at an enviable pace but at Burj construction values remains steadfast. Burj construction takes great pride in everything that we do and the project we have delivered are proud examples what can be achieve when brilliant minds come together determined to make a difference to the world we live in.

Our homes have always been about prime location easy access superior amenities and pleasant surroundings attention to details superior quality maximization of resources and elegant aesthetics are just some of the standard we demand throughout our projects. when we build, the entire process from design to execution to its final delivery we try to ensure that experience of living and working is truly unparalleled. our relationships are rooted in trust and integrity, which allows us to foster long-lasting relationships with our clients.

entry.question: What are the prices or rates for your apartments?
entry.answer: Pricing is not published online and varies by project, floor, and unit configuration. Please contact the sales team on +91 98199 62446 (call or WhatsApp) or email Latifcorp@aol.com for current rates and availability.

entry.question: Are there any units currently available for sale?
entry.answer: Availability changes frequently and is not published online. Please contact the sales team on +91 98199 62446 or email Latifcorp@aol.com to check current availability.

entry.question: How can I book a site visit?
entry.answer: Site visits can be arranged by calling or messaging +91 98199 62446 on WhatsApp, or by emailing Latifcorp@aol.com. The office is open Monday to Saturday, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

entry.question: Where are your projects located?
entry.answer: All current projects are in South Mumbai. Burj Ashrafi and Burj Chishti are on Kambekar Street off Mohammed Ali Road (Mumbai 400003), Burj Classic is in Dongri, and Burj Qadri is in Agripada near Mumbai Central.

entry.question: Do you handle commercial as well as residential projects?
entry.answer: Yes. Burj Ashrafi, Burj Classic, Burj Qadri, and Burj Chishti are all listed as commercial and residential developments.

entry.question: What is the RERA registration number for a project?
entry.answer: RERA certificates are published as downloadable PDFs on each project page of burjconstructions.com. For the registration number itself, please contact the team on +91 98199 62446 or email Latifcorp@aol.com.
